failure_taxonomy.method: primary cause = first failure in the causal chain (activity -> gross edge -> cost -> cost-stress -> time -> instrument -> multiplicity); secondary causes listed separately

qualitative_categories.G_NEIGHBORHOOD_INSTABILITY: raw-positive candidates sit on isolated parameter points whose family neighborhood is negative (e.g. V3-0016/0046 Donchian are single-trade wins; V3-0738/0739/0740 are 1-trade Kalman wins)
qualitative_categories.I_REGIME_SPECIFIC: 10 net-positive candidates have >70% of gross edge in a single calendar year (year_concentrated); the 4 USDJPY trend-pullback positives are regime/turnover specific
qualitative_categories.J_MODEL_CAPACITY_MISMATCH: families are linear/threshold/hand-crafted; the signal class is too rigid to capture the (absent) effect, see model_class_review
qualitative_categories.K_DATA_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH: V3_E_TICK_ARRIVAL_INTENSITY and V3_E_ORDER_BOOK_IMBALANCE were rejected pre-outcome (need tick-arrival / order-book depth that the M1 bid/ask set does not contain) -> UNTESTED, not refuted
qualitative_categories.L_HORIZON_MISMATCH: H2/H3 candidates are price-alpha-only (not fully executable: overnight financing unsupported); H0 micro is cost-dominated

cost_decomposition.method: mid-to-mid zero-cost gross back-solved from the linear cost model: gross = 3*net_1x - 2*net_1_5x; total_cost_1x = 2*(net_1x - net_1_5x) = spread overlay + 0.20 bps/fill x fills. Cost model NOT changed.

program_level.interpretation: of the 823 A-candidates with trades, 515 have negative mid-to-mid gross (no edge before costs) and 288 have positive gross that costs destroy; only 20 are net-positive at 1x, and none survive the full frozen predicate

program_level_conclusion.primary_conclusion: A. repeated absence of alpha under price-only public FX M1 data is the dominant, best-supported explanation (3 generations, 1388 trials, WRC p~1.0). C. execution-cost dominance is a strong secondary cause for the gross-positive families (costs consume 286-450% of gross). D. missing microstructure information is a strong cause for the UNTESTED (rejected pre-outcome) microstructure families. B/E/F/G are weaker: model class was mostly simple (B), H0 is cost-hostile but H1 was tested (E), only USD majors (F), validation was rigorous (G).

evidence_strength.E_wrong_horizon: MODERATE (H0 cost-hostile; H1 tested; H2/H3 not executable)

v4_go_no_go.rationale: The price-only M1 public-FX information set is exhausted for the tested intraday hypothesis classes (3 generations, 1388 trials, WRC p~1.0, 0 survivors). The dominant failure is NO_SIGNAL (48%) with COST_DOMINANCE (27%) for the gross-positive families. Crucially, the MOST PROMISING intraday hypothesis class - market microstructure - was REJECTED pre-outcome because it requires tick/order-book data the M1 set does not contain, so it is UNTESTED, not refuted. A V4 on the SAME data is therefore NOT justified; a future program requires a NEW data class (tick/L2) or a different market/horizon with lower relative cost.
v4_go_no_go.not_v4_justified_because: no new hypothesis class is testable and likely-successful on the current price-only M1 set; the gross-positive families are cost-suppressed, not edge-lacking, but the cost structure is a property of the arena, not fixable by model choice
if_proceeding_information_classes: multi-day or futures price data for lower relative cost (NEW market/horizon)
hypothesis_classes_worth_testing: microstructure (quote-arrival, order-book) - now testable with new data
richer state-space / latent-factor on existing data (X4)
classes_to_ban: parameter sweeps around the 20 raw-positive failure modes
prospective_safeguards: freeze the statistical protocol + survivor predicate BEFORE any V4 outcome
keep the 2018+ holdout sealed and independent
pre-register the new data class and its capability contract
no V4 candidate may be seeded from a V3 raw-positive parameter

holdout_recommendation.rationale: the sealed 2018+ region is the program's most valuable remaining independent evidence. V3 ended with no survivor, so consuming it now would spend independent evidence on a null result. It should be reserved for a future GENUINELY NEW prospective program (new data class or new arena) that first clears a pre-2018 gate.
